title: Accounts
subtitle: Manage upstream provider accounts, supported protocols and model mappings. The gateway dispatches requests by priority and health.

empty.hint: No upstream accounts yet. Add one to start serving models through the gateway.

resetHealth.confirm: Reset this account's health? Cooldown will be cleared and it will be marked available.

delete.confirm: Delete account "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

form.providerHint: Built-in providers pre-fill the base URL and available protocols; the custom provider connects to any OpenAI-compatible service.
form.accountTypeExtra: Each account type uses its own base URL; switching updates it automatically.
form.typeExtra: Choose one of Text / Image / Embedding. Cannot be changed after creation.
form.name: Name
form.nameExtra: Display name used in lists, logs and the overview.
form.baseUrlExtra: Pre-filled for built-in providers; edit if needed.
form.baseUrlCustomExtra: Enter an OpenAI-compatible base URL, usually ending with /v1.
form.baseUrlInvalid: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://
form.apiKeyExtra: Stored encrypted and only used to call the upstream service.
form.apiKeyEditPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved key
form.protocolsExtra: Clients can call this account with the selected protocols; with protocol conversion enabled the gateway converts between them automatically.
form.protocolsNone: This provider has no protocols available for the selected type.
form.mappingsExtra: Clients call the "request model"; the gateway replaces it with the "upstream model" when forwarding. 1–100 rows; request model names must be unique within the account.
form.mappingsMin: Add at least one model mapping
form.mappingsEmpty: No mappings yet. Add one manually or discover models from the upstream.
form.testModelPlaceholder: Pick from the upstream models in your mappings
form.testModelExtra: Used for a minimal validation call on save; image accounts are not actually called.
form.enabledExtra: When disabled the gateway will not dispatch requests to this account.

discover.title: Discover Models
discover.needBaseUrl: Fill in the base URL first
discover.needKey: Fill in the API key first
discover.hint: Already-mapped models are pre-checked and locked; newly checked models are added as mappings with the same name.

mappings.title: Model mappings
mappings.deleteConfirm: Delete mapping {{name}}? The model becomes unavailable immediately.
